_howto: Employee Master tours. steps = page tour (first visit). sections = one tour per area, starts the first time that area is opened. guides = hands-on how-to guides in the ? menu. To announce something NEW, add a step with a NEW id. Rewording keeps the id. Never reuse an id.
title: Employee Master tour
whatsNewText: We've added something new here since you last took the tour.

steps.title: Welcome to Employee Master
steps.text:
This is your employee directory: everyone's profile, departments, access to clocking devices, teams, leave setup and reporting lines.

Use Next and Back, or your arrow keys. Press Esc to close.

steps.title: All Employee Master areas
steps.text: Every area of Employee Master is listed here. You only see the areas your role allows.

steps.title: Active Personnel
steps.text: Everyone currently employed. Create, view and edit employees, and import, export or sync them in bulk.

steps.title: Terminated Records
steps.text: Employees who have left. Their history is kept, and they can be reinstated.

steps.title: Departments
steps.text: Your department structure, including cost centres and company rules.

steps.title: Access Roles
steps.text: Which access zones (groups of clocking devices) each department's employees can use.

steps.title: Custom Teams
steps.text: Groups of employees across departments, such as crews or shifts.

steps.title: Leave Management
steps.text: Your leave types and employees' leave balances.

steps.title: Custom Attributes
steps.text: Your own extra fields and lists, such as employee types and cost centres.

steps.title: Org Hierarchy
steps.text: Your organogram: reporting lines, managers and levels.

steps.title: Audit & History
steps.text: Who changed which employee record, and when.

steps.title: Data Reports
steps.text: Reports and exports of your employee data.

steps.title: Make more room
steps.text: Collapse the menu to icons only, and click again to open it.

steps.title: Where you are
steps.text: The name of the area that is open right now.

steps.title: Your menu
steps.text: Click your name for Toggle Theme, Back to Launchpad and Logout.

steps.title: Search any screen
steps.text:
Type what you're looking for, like leave or roster, to jump straight to any screen you have access to, in any module.

Point at the search bar without typing to see your most visited screens, and pin your favourites.

steps.title: Your menu
steps.text: Click your name for your profile, other areas of the system, and logout. Let's look inside.

steps.title: Launchpad
steps.text: Back to your home screen with all your modules.

steps.title: Profile
steps.text: Update your name and email address, or change your password.

steps.title: Settings
steps.text: Company-wide setup. Only shown to users allowed to change settings.

steps.title: ESS
steps.text: Your own self service: leave, claims, payslips and documents.

steps.title: Connect a Phone
steps.text: Shows a QR code that connects a company phone to your company. It contains your licence key, so only show it while setting up phones.

steps.title: Download the App
steps.text: Shows a QR code to download the Android app onto a phone.

steps.title: Help & Tours
steps.text: Opens the same help menu as the ? button.

steps.title: Dark Mode
steps.text: Switch between dark and light. Your choice follows your login to any computer.

steps.title: Logout
steps.text: Always log out on a shared computer.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: Click ? for this page tour, a tour of the area you're in, and anything new.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.text: Each Employee Master area also has its own short tour. It starts the first time you open that area, and you can replay it any time from ?.

steps.title: Search
steps.text: Find an employee by name or PIN as you type.

steps.title: Department Filter
steps.text: Show only one department's employees.

steps.title: Employee Type
steps.text: Show only one type of employee, such as Permanent or Seasonal, or a type you added in Custom Attributes.

steps.title: Options
steps.text: Missing photo shows employees without a profile photo. Pending start shows employees whose start date is still in the future (the number shows how many). The PIN sorting option makes PINs like A10 and B10 sort simply as 10.

steps.title: Data Tools
steps.text:
Custom Blank Template and Custom Export Data give you a spreadsheet with the columns you choose. Fill in the template and load it with the Data Import Wizard.

Bulk Upload Photos: choose a folder of photos named by PIN (for example 1001.jpg). Generate Missing Logins creates a locked-down login for every active employee who doesn't have one.

steps.title: Hardware
steps.text:
Sync Personnel pulls new employees from your clocking devices, or pushes your latest employee data to them. Pull History Logs asks every device to upload its full punch history.

Push All to Hardware wipes the devices and loads only active, authorised employees. Use it with care.

steps.title: Sage Sync
steps.text: Pull new or updated employees from Sage 300, or push your changes to Sage 300.

steps.title: Create Employee
steps.text: Opens the new employee form. It has five tabs: Personal, Employment, Leave & Payroll, HR & Benefits and Docs & History.

steps.title: The employee list
steps.text: Click a column heading to sort by it. Right-click the heading row to choose which columns are shown.

steps.title: Change many employees at once
steps.text: Tick employees (or this box for the whole page) and a toolbar appears to Set Manager, Assign HOD, Move Department or Terminate them all together.

steps.title: View
steps.text: Opens the employee's profile to read, without changing anything.

steps.title: Edit
steps.text: Opens the employee's profile to make changes.

steps.title: Terminate
steps.text: Ends the employee's employment. They move to Terminated Records, where their history is kept and they can be reinstated.

steps.title: Pages
steps.text: Choose 50, 100 or 200 rows per page, and use the arrows to move between pages.

steps.title: Search
steps.text: Find a former employee by name or PIN.

steps.title: Department
steps.text: Show only one department's former employees.

steps.title: Reason
steps.text: Show only one reason for leaving, such as Resigned, Dismissed, Retrenched, End of Season or End of Contract.

steps.title: Reinstate several at once
steps.text: Tick former employees (or this box for the whole page) and use Bulk Reinstate to bring them all back to Active Personnel. Handy at the start of a new season.

steps.title: History
steps.text: Every time this person was terminated and reinstated, with the dates and reasons.

steps.title: Edit details
steps.text: Correct the termination details, such as the date or reason, without reinstating the person.

steps.title: Reinstate
steps.text: Brings the person back to Active Personnel with their history kept.

steps.title: Pages
steps.text: Choose how many rows per page, and use the arrows to move between pages.

steps.title: Three tabs
steps.text: Departments & Zones, Company Rules and Cost Centres.

steps.title: Sync Departments
steps.text: Pulls your departments from your ZKTeco server, so both systems use the same structure.

steps.title: Create Dept
steps.text: Add a new department with its code, name, parent department and head(s) of department.

steps.title: Search
steps.text: Find a department by name or code.

steps.title: Status
steps.text: Show active departments (the default), deactivated ones, or all of them.

steps.title: Change several at once
steps.text: Tick departments (or this box for all of them) and use Assign Parent to put them all under the same parent department.

steps.title: Edit
steps.text: Change the department's name, parent department or head(s) of department.

steps.title: Deactivate
steps.text: Closes a department. You choose where its active employees move to, the date and the reason. A deactivated department can be reactivated later.

steps.title: Company Rules
steps.text: Operational rules or policies you assign to departments. Create Rule asks for a name, a description and the departments it applies to.

steps.title: Cost Centres
steps.text: Cost centres for financial reporting. Add one with a code and name, then link employees to it on their profile.

steps.title: Access by department
steps.text: Each department and the access zones its employees can use. Zones are groups of clocking devices, created in Settings > Access Zones.

steps.title: Search
steps.text: Find a department by name.

steps.title: Assign Zones
steps.text: Choose which zones the whole department can use. Every employee in the department gets access to those devices.

steps.title: Sync Device
steps.text: Sends this department's authorised employees to its devices. Anyone not authorised is removed from those devices, so check the zones first.

steps.title: Create Team
steps.text: A team groups employees from any department under one team leader, such as a crew or a shift. Give it a name, choose the leader, then tick the members. You can filter by department, show only the selected members, or select everyone in the filtered list.

steps.title: Search
steps.text: Find a team by name.

steps.title: Your teams
steps.text: Each team, its leader and how many members it has.

steps.title: Edit
steps.text: Change the team's name, leader or members.

steps.title: Delete
steps.text: Removes the team and takes all its members out of it. The employees' own records are not changed.

steps.title: Add a leave type
steps.text: Type a name (for example Annual Leave or Sick Leave), choose Paid or Unpaid, and add it. Paid leave types appear on every employee's profile so their balances can be managed.

steps.title: Your leave types
steps.text: Every leave type your company uses. Use Edit to rename it or change whether it's paid.

steps.title: Pull Balances
steps.text: Brings employees' current leave balances in from Sage 300 and shows a report of what changed. The time of the last pull is shown next to the button.

steps.title: Push Leave
steps.text: Sends approved leave to Sage 300. You choose how many days back to include (up to 60), and a report shows what was sent and what wasn't. The button is greyed out when leave push is switched off in Settings > Connectivity > Sage.

steps.title: Sync history
steps.text: Every pull from and push to Sage, with who ran it and the results. Use Refresh to see the latest.

steps.title: Two tabs
steps.text: Employee Attributes are your own extra fields. Employee Types are your own employment types.

steps.title: Add a field
steps.text: Create a field your company needs, such as Boot Size or Tractor Licence. Choose its type: Text, Number, Date or Yes/No. It then appears on every employee's profile.

steps.title: Your fields
steps.text: The extra fields you've created. Deleting one hides it from every employee's profile.

steps.title: Fill them in bulk
steps.text: Export a spreadsheet of these fields (for one department or PIN if you like), fill it in, and load it back with the upload button next to it. Much quicker than editing profiles one by one.

steps.title: Employee Types
steps.text: Add your own employment types, such as Contractor or Temp. They appear in the employee type lists across Employee Master. Edit or deactivate them here. Deactivating a type clears it from any employees who have it, so you can reassign them.

steps.title: Four tabs
steps.text: Org Chart, Manager Assignments, Stand-in Delegations and Hierarchy Levels.

steps.title: Org Chart
steps.text: Your company's structure as a chart. Use Refresh Chart after making changes.

steps.title: Manager Assignments
steps.text: Link a system user to one or more parts of the hierarchy. That manager can then see those employees and handle their workflow approvals. Pick the user, pick the nodes, then assign.

steps.title: Stand-in Delegations
steps.text: While a manager is away, send their approvals to a stand-in. Choose the manager, the stand-in and the start and end dates.

steps.title: Hierarchy Levels
steps.text: Name the levels of your structure, for example Company, Region and Department. The diagram shows how they stack.

steps.title: Filters
steps.text: Limit a report to one department and, optionally, a date range. The dates apply to start dates or termination dates.

steps.title: Full Employee Details
steps.text: Everything about every active employee, including HR and Time & Attendance fields.

steps.title: Missing Photo
steps.text: Active employees without a profile photo.

steps.title: Potential Duplicates
steps.text: Employees with the same first and last name, so you can check for double entries.

steps.title: Terminated Employees
steps.text: Everyone who has been terminated, with their start and termination dates.

steps.title: Pending Terminations
steps.text: Active employees with a termination date still to come.

steps.title: Missing Info
steps.text: Active employees missing important details: ID number, start date, department or shift.

steps.title: Preview and export
steps.text: The report appears here first. Search it, then Export to Excel or Export to PDF.

steps.title: Find a change
steps.text: Search by PIN, name or action, and filter by the user who made the change and a date range. Clear resets the filters.

steps.title: Every change to employee records
steps.text: Each profile created, edited, terminated or moved to another department: when, which employee, what was done, the details, and who did it.

steps.title: More results
steps.text: Use the arrows to move through the pages.
